#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    long cap, f;
    Edge(int to, int rev, long cap) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
};

class Maxflow {
public:
    Maxflow(int n) : graph(n) {}

    void addEdge(int s, int t, long cap) {
        graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, (int)graph[t].size(), cap));
        graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, (int)graph[s].size() - 1, 0));
    }

    bool dinicBFS(int src, int dest, vector<int>& dist) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
        dist[src] = 0;
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(src);
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front();
            Q.pop();
            for (auto e : graph[u]) {
                if (dist[e.to] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[dest] >= 0;
    }

    long dinicDFS(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, long f) {
        if (u == dest) return f;
        for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            auto e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
            if (dist[e.to] == dist[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, e.to, min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                if (df > 0) {
                    e.f += df;
                    graph[e.to][e.rev].f -= df;
                    return df;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    long maxFLow(int src, int dest) {
        long flow = 0;
        vector<int> dist(graph.size());
        while (dinicBFS(src, dest, dist)) {
            vector<int> ptr(graph.size());
            while (true) {
                long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, src, numeric_limits<long>::max());
                if (df == 0) break;
                flow += df;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

private:
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
};

class MinCostFlowBF {
public:
    MinCostFlowBF(int n) : graph(n) {}

    void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, (int)graph[t].size(), cap, cost));
        graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, (int)graph[s].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevnode, vector<int>& prevedge, vector<int>& curflow) {
        int n = graph.size();
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), numeric_limits<int>::max());
        dist[s] = 0;
        curflow[s] = numeric_limits<int>::max();
        vector<bool> inqueue(n);
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(s);
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front();
            Q.pop();
            inqueue[u] = false;
            for (auto e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                int v = e.to;
                int ndist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (dist[v] > ndist) {
                    dist[v] = ndist;
                    prevnode[v] = u;
                    prevedge[v] = (int)graph[u].size() - 1 - (int)graph[v].size() + e.rev;
                    curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                    if (!inqueue[v]) {
                        inqueue[v] = true;
                        Q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pair<int, int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
        int n = graph.size();
        vector<int> dist(n);
        vector<int> curflow(n);
        vector<int> prevedge(n);
        vector<int> prevnode(n);

        int flow = 0;
        int flowCost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            bellmanFord(s, dist, prevnode, prevedge, curflow);
            if (dist[t] == numeric_limits<int>::max())
                break;
            int df = min(curflow[t], maxf - flow);
            flow += df;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                auto e = graph[prevnode[v]].back();
                e.f += df;
                graph[v].back().f -= df;
                flowCost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return make_pair(flow, flowCost);
    }

private:
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
};

class Task {
public:
    void solve(istream& sc, ostream& pw) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int T = 100;
        MinCostFlowBF mf = MinCostFlowBF((T + 1) * n + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (sc.nextInt() > 0)
                mf.addEdge(0, i + 1, sc.nextInt(), 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, k, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, (T + 1) * n + 1, 1, c * i);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int b = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                int cost = 0;
                for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + a, 1 + (j + 1) * n + b, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                    mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + b, 1 + (j + 1) * n + a, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                    cost = l * l * d;
                }
            }
        }
        auto flowAndCost = mf.minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * n + 1, k);
        pw << flowAndCost.second << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task t;
    t.solve(cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
